validate.returns: Problem[] {path,message} (empty when valid; throws on an unusable schema)

getRule.returns: T (throws when the path is missing and no fallback is given)

requireRules.returns: rules (throws with every problem listed; server)

readSchema.returns: Schema (default: the shipped envelope schema; server)

value.returns: unknown (the rule at the dotted path, undefined when the rules have none; a method of RulesReader)

has.returns: boolean (a method of RulesReader; same as hasRule)

rulesLocation.returns: {rulesFile,schemaFile} (<folder>/<name>.json and <folder>/<name>.schema.json; RangeError unless name is a lower-case slug; server)

loadRulesSettings.returns: RulesReader (loads the named rules file and its schema, throws with every problem listed; server)

notes: Engine form: `value(path)` over checked rules, from createRulesSettings(rules) or loadRulesSettings({rulesFile, strict}, folder). The `rulesFile` setting is a name (grammar slug, default house-rules), not a path: the rules are <folder>/<name>.json with their schema beside them as <folder>/<name>.schema.json, the folder being where the application installs its rules.
